skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept of e-commerce and its development stages, classify basic types of e-commerce.
Apply knowledge and skills related to e-commerce used in businesses (website management, electronic marketing, e-commerce strategy management...)

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Utilization of Networking and Internet Technologies
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand how to apply knowledge about networking, internet, 4.0 technologies, information systems, and data in e-commerce to serve domestic and international business operations.

Possess skills to synthesize, analyze, and evaluate data and information related to e-commerce, macro and micro environments affecting e-commerce activities to develop strategies and business models for enterprises.

Understand website management skills, platforms for building e-commerce websites, opening and managing online stores on e-commerce platforms, applying e-commerce to support business activities (e-CRM, electronic marketing, electronic payment...).
Enhance independent communication skills through reading assigned materials after each lecture, strengthen teamwork skills through group assignments.

Possess the ability to self-study and independently research to complete assigned lessons and tasks, identify and solve common practical problems in e-commerce, thereby improving professional expertise in e-commerce.
